title: "What even is…?": say you don't get it while doing exactly that
summary: Put "what even is ___?" on screen, then show yourself fully doing that very thing. AI helps you find the funniest lines.
why: New Engen's Instagram trends list, updated November 2, 2026, includes a "what is…" format: creators ask on screen what a habit or aesthetic even is, while the clip shows them leaning into the opposite. The page suggests a straight face, text held for 2–3 seconds and a Reel under 15 seconds.
steps: Pick a habit, trend or look you claim not to understand, but that is secretly (or not so secretly) your whole life.
Use the main prompt to get short "what even is…?" lines with a matching shot for each.
Film a short clip of you fully committed to the thing. Keep a flat, serious face.
Put the line on screen for 2–3 seconds, keep the whole clip under 15 seconds and post with original sound or a voice-over.

prompts.label: Main prompt
prompts.text: Help me with a short deadpan video. Write 8 on-screen lines in the pattern "what even is [thing]??" where the thing is a habit, trend or style I pretend not to understand. For each line, add the shot that proves I'm fully into it, for example "what even is a cosy night in??" over me wrapped in three blankets with tea and a candle. Here's my life: [your hobbies, habits and little obsessions]. Keep each line under 8 words. No swearing, no hashtags, no emojis.

prompts.label: Variation: the reverse
prompts.text: Flip the joke. Write 6 lines in the pattern "what even is [thing]??" where the thing is something I clearly never do, and the shot shows me doing the exact opposite. Example: "what even is a quick grocery run??" over me with a cart that's full to the top. About me: [a few honest habits]. Keep it light and kind to myself.

prompts.label: Variation: plan the shot
prompts.text: I'm filming one "what even is…?" clip. The line is: "[your line]". Give me a simple shot plan I can do with my phone in 10 minutes: where to set the camera, what to wear, what props to use, and one small action that makes the joke land. Keep the clip under 15 seconds.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: I run [type of business] in [town]. Write 6 "what even is [thing]??" lines that poke fun at something our business is clearly obsessed with, like [one or two real examples, for example: a tidy shelf, one more coat of paint, extra cheese]. For each, describe a real behind-the-scenes shot from our day. Then write one short caption. Don't make up sales, numbers or customer quotes.

tips: The flat face is the joke. Don't smile or wink at the camera.
Pick something specific. "What even is a second coffee??" beats "what even is caffeine??".
Keep the text near the top of the screen so it isn't hidden by captions and buttons.
Original sound or a voice-over works for any account, including business accounts.
